_comment: CONTRACT FIXTURE v1 (2026-09-25) — the single shared shape for POST /v1/tools/{name}, the SDK passthrough route. Every shipped SDK client test (sdk/go/kernsdk/client_test.go, sdk/python/test_client.py, sdk/typescript/test/client.test.mjs) loads THIS file and asserts its client's behavior against each case, so a route-shape change (envelope, status mapping, error body) fails all three suites until the clients are updated. The server-side contract is pinned by internal/web/tools_passthrough_test.go. Run all three suites in sequence with sdk/contract/verify.sh (fails on the first failure). Version this file (bump _version, note the change here) whenever the route shape changes.
request_envelope: the tool's argument map (JSON object); tool name in the URL path

status_mapping.403: governed denial (KERN_TOOLS allowlist, root confinement, RBAC) — body {"error": "tool call denied"}
status_mapping.500: generic tool failure — body {"error": "tool call failed"} (detail logged server-side, never returned)
